notes: Images are factual existing school insignia, downloaded rather than generated or redrawn.
All nine PNG files were opened and visually inspected for the correct school and completeness.
PNG originals are stored unchanged under stable filenames. Lanxiang's JPEG original is preserved and a PNG format conversion is also provided.
Preserve each image's intrinsic aspect ratio when fitting it into game tokens.
No missing assets. Lanxiang official website could not be fetched; its image was verified from the school name visible in the emblem, its Baike entry and a second descriptive reference.
School-emblem copyright/trademark rights remain with the respective schools; no broad open-content or commercial-use license was found.
